reason: I'm not handing my clients' Autotask tickets and contracts to a company I've never heard of, DPA or not. And I've paid for a reporting tool before that nobody opened after the first month, so £240 a month for another one isn't happening this week.
objection: It's my clients' data and my reputation if it leaks or gets misused. A signed DPA from an unknown startup doesn't mean much if they fold or get breached, and my client contracts may not even let me share it.
would_change_my_mind: Another UK MSP owner I know and trust telling me they ran the audit, it found real money they actually billed, and it took under an hour of their time.
